theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 23 群

items.pos: v. 同意；給予 | n. 補助金
items.colloc: grant permission 同意許可 | research grant 研究補助金
items.distinct: award 獎項；獎金 | subsidy 津貼；補貼
ex: The manager granted his request for leave.
經理同意了他的請假請求。
They received a grant for the project.
他們為該專案獲得了一筆補助金。
We cannot grant access to non-employees.
我們無法給予非員工訪問權限。

items.pos: v. 保證 | n. 保證；保固
items.colloc: guarantee quality 品質保證 | money-back guarantee 退款保證
items.distinct: warrant 擔保；授權 | promise 承諾
ex: This product comes with a two-year guarantee.
這項產品附帶兩年保固。
We cannot guarantee delivery by tomorrow.
我們無法保證明天前能送達。
Satisfied customers are our best guarantee.
滿意的顧客是我們最好的保證。

items.pos: v. 兌現；尊重 | n. 榮譽
items.colloc: honour a contract 履行合約 | in honour of 為紀念
items.distinct: respect 尊敬 | credit 功勞；信用
ex: The company failed to honour the agreement.
這家公司未能履行協議。
It is an honour to work with you.
與您共事是我的榮幸。
Please honour the discount coupon before expiration.
請在過期前兌現這張折價券。

items.pos: v. 說明；圖解
items.colloc: illustrate a point 闡明觀點 | clearly illustrate 清晰說明
items.distinct: explain 解釋 | demonstrate 示範；證明
ex: The charts illustrate our sales growth.
這些圖表說明了我們的銷售成長。
She used examples to illustrate the concept.
她用例子來說明這個概念。
The manual illustrates how to assemble parts.
這份手冊圖解了如何組裝零件。

items.pos: adj. 感到印象深刻的
items.colloc: be impressed by 對…感到印象深刻 | highly impressed 極為佩服
items.distinct: impressive 令人印象深刻的 | impressive 氣派的
ex: The client was impressed by our presentation.
客戶對我們的簡報感到印象深刻。
I am impressed with his professional attitude.
我對他專業的態度感到佩服。
Everyone was impressed by the new design.
大家都對這項新設計感到驚艷。

items.pos: v. 指出；顯示
items.colloc: indicate a preference 表達偏好 | clearly indicate 明確指出
items.distinct: show 顯示 | specify 詳細說明
ex: Recent data indicate a rise in costs.
最近的數據顯示成本上升。
Please indicate your arrival time below.
請在下方註明您的抵達時間。
The arrow indicates the emergency exit.
箭頭指示了緊急出口的方向。

items.pos: n. 行業；工業
items.colloc: the tech industry 科技產業 | industry standards 產業標準
items.distinct: factory 工廠 | business 商業；企業
ex: He has worked in the tourism industry.
他在旅遊業工作過。
The industry is facing significant challenges.
該產業正面臨重大挑戰。
We must adhere to strict industry standards.
我們必須遵守嚴格的產業標準。

items.pos: n. 資訊；資料
items.colloc: provide information 提供資訊 | confidential information 機密資料
items.distinct: data 數據 | knowledge 知識
ex: Please find the requested information attached.
請參閱附件中所要求的資料。
We need more information to decide.
我們需要更多資訊來做決定。
All personal information will remain private.
所有個人資料將保持隱私。

items.pos: v. 打斷；中斷
items.colloc: interrupt a meeting 中斷會議 | avoid interrupting 避免打擾
items.distinct: disturb 打擾 | interfere 干涉
ex: Sorry to interrupt your busy schedule.
抱歉打斷您繁忙的行程。
The rain interrupted the outdoor event.
雨水中斷了戶外活動的進行。
Please do not interrupt him while speaking.
他發言時請不要打斷他。

items.pos: v. 包含；涉及
items.colloc: involve in 參與 | be involved with 與…有關
items.distinct: include 包含 | contain 內含
ex: The job will involve frequent business trips.
這份工作將涉及頻繁的出差。
We want to involve the whole team.
我們希望讓整個團隊參與其中。
These tasks involve complex technical skills.
這些任務涉及複雜的技術能力。

items.pos: n. 聯盟；等級
items.colloc: major league 主要聯盟 | in a different league 不同等級
items.distinct: association 協會 | union 工會
ex: They joined the international trade league.
他們加入了國際貿易聯盟。
Their performance is in a different league.
他們的表現屬於不同的等級。
The league announced the new rules today.
聯盟今天宣布了新規範。

items.pos: v. 離開；留下 | n. 請假；休假
items.colloc: take leave 請假 | sick leave 病假
items.distinct: quit 辭職 | depart 出發
ex: He is on leave for two weeks.
他請了兩週的假。
Please leave your message after the beep.
請在嗶聲後留下您的訊息。
We have to leave for the airport now.
我們現在必須出發前往機場。

items.pos: adj. 很可能的 | adv. 很可能
items.colloc: be likely to 很有可能 | most likely 最有可能
items.distinct: possible 可能的 | probable 有把握的
ex: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
今天下午很有可能會下雨。
We are likely to finish by Friday.
我們很有可能在週五前完成。
What is the most likely outcome here?
這裡最可能的結果是什麼？

items.pos: n. 限度；限制 | v. 限制
items.colloc: time limit 時間限制 | set a limit 設定限制
items.distinct: restriction 限制法規 | barrier 障礙
ex: There is a limit to our budget.
我們的預算是有上限的。
We must limit the number of attendees.
我們必須限制出席人數。
He reached his limit during the workout.
他在運動時達到了體能極限。

items.pos: v. 降低 | adj. 較低的
items.colloc: lower costs 降低成本 | lower price 較低的價格
items.distinct: reduce 減少 | decrease 減少
ex: We plan to lower our operational costs.
我們計畫降低營運成本。
The company offered a lower rate today.
公司今天提供了較低的費率。
Can you lower the volume a little?
你可以把音量稍微調低嗎？

items.pos: v. 管理；設法處理
items.colloc: manage a team 管理團隊 | manage time 時間管理
items.distinct: handle 處理 | operate 操作
ex: She manages the marketing department well.
她把行銷部門管理得很好。
Did you manage to fix the printer?
你設法修好印表機了嗎？
I cannot manage this workload alone.
我無法獨自處理這些工作量。

items.pos: v. 標示；慶祝 | n. 標記；分數
items.colloc: mark the deadline 標示截止日 | high marks 高分
items.distinct: label 貼標籤 | sign 簽名
ex: Please mark the calendar for the meeting.
請在行事曆上標示會議日期。
The event marks our tenth anniversary.
這項活動標誌著我們的十週年。
Check the marks on the quality report.
檢查品質報告上的標記。

items.pos: v. 移動；搬遷 | n. 舉措；行動
items.colloc: move to a new office 搬到新辦公室 | a strategic move 策略行動
items.distinct: shift 轉移 | relocate 遷移
ex: The head office will move next month.
總公司下個月將會搬遷。
That was a wise move for the company.
對公司來說那是一個明智的舉措。
We need to move forward with the plan.
我們需要推動這項計畫。

items.pos: v. 注意到 | n. 公告；通知
items.colloc: give notice 預告 | until further notice 在另行通知前
items.distinct: attention 注意力 | warning 警告
ex: Did you notice the error in the file?
你有注意到檔案裡的錯誤嗎？
Please read the notice on the door.
請閱讀門上的公告。
He gave two weeks' notice before quitting.
他在離職前預告了兩週。

items.pos: adv. 起初；原先
items.colloc: originally planned 原先計畫 | originally from 來自
items.distinct: initially 最初 | primarily 主要地
ex: The project was originally due on Monday.
這項專案原先預計週一截止。
This building was originally a library.
這棟建築原先是一座圖書館。
He is originally from a small town.
他原本來自一個小鎮。
